scheme_name: Interest Subvention Scheme For Housing Loan For Regular State Government Employee Under APUN GHAR
other_conditions: At least 5 years of residual service are required
Must be a permanent employee of the Assam State Government
Only one application is allowed per employee during their service tenure
Application must be made within 2 years of the Government Office Memorandum/Notification
Employees without an SBI salary account or with an SBI account for less than 1 year must submit a No Dues certificate from their previous bank
Loan amount up to the prescribed limit (₹15 lakh) is covered by the subvention; amounts above this limit are not eligible for the interest benefit
Close relatives can apply jointly only if all are Assam government employees, with the loan limit combined under the scheme
Persons who have already benefited under the Apun Ghar scheme are not eligible
Purchase of an ancestral plot of land from close relatives (parents, spouse, siblings, children) is excluded
Pensionable employees may have loan repayment extended up to age 70, non‑pensionable employees up to age 60
benefits_summary: Provides a 3.5 % interest subvention on housing loans up to ₹15 lakh, resulting in reduced interest rates of 5 % for women and 5.05 % for men, with repayment possible up to age 70 for pensionable employees.
documents_required: Salary Certificate (including deduction details, grade, date of joining, date of retirement, nature of service)
No Dues certificate from existing/previous banker (if no SBI salary account or account held for less than 1 year)
Check‑off letter from the Drawing and Disbursing Officer
